/**
 * Plugin bootstrap: hooks, attribute registration and editor assets.
 *
 * @package SmartMediaMarkup
 */

namespace Smart_Media_Markup;

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Wires the plugin into WordPress.
 */
final class Plugin {

	/**
	 * Name of the Image block attribute that enables caption-as-alt.
	 */
	const CAPTION_ALT_ATTRIBUTE = 'smartMediaCaptionAlt';

	/**
	 * Editor script handle.
	 */
	const EDITOR_HANDLE = 'smart-media-markup-editor';

	/**
	 * Registers hooks.
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public static function init() {
		add_action( 'init', array( __CLASS__, 'register_render_filters' ) );
		add_filter( 'register_block_type_args', array( __CLASS__, 'register_image_attribute' ), 10, 2 );
		add_action( 'enqueue_block_editor_assets', array( __CLASS__, 'enqueue_editor_assets' ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the block names whose rendered output is processed.
	 *
	 * @return string[]
	 */
	public static function get_block_names() {
		/**
		 * Filters the blocks whose front-end markup Smart Media Markup improves.
		 *
		 * @param string[] $block_names Block names.
		 */
		$block_names = apply_filters(
			'smart_media_markup_block_names',
			array( 'core/image', 'core/gallery', 'core/cover' )
		);

		return array_values( array_unique( array_filter( array_map( 'strval', (array) $block_names ) ) ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Adds a `render_block_{$name}` filter for every supported block.
	 *
	 * Rendering filters only touch the HTML sent to the browser; the stored
	 * post content is never changed.
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public static function register_render_filters() {
		foreach ( self::get_block_names() as $block_name ) {
			add_filter( "render_block_{$block_name}", array( __CLASS__, 'filter_block_output' ), 10, 2 );
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Filters the rendered HTML of a supported block.
	 *
	 * @param string $block_content Rendered block HTML.
	 * @param array  $block         Parsed block.
	 * @return string
	 */
	public static function filter_block_output( $block_content, $block ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $block_content ) || '' === $block_content ) {
			return $block_content;
		}

		$block_name = isset( $block['blockName'] ) ? (string) $block['blockName'] : '';
		$attrs      = isset( $block['attrs'] ) && is_array( $block['attrs'] ) ? $block['attrs'] : array();

		return Markup_Processor::process(
			$block_content,
			array(
				'caption_as_alt' => 'core/image' === $block_name && ! empty( $attrs[ self::CAPTION_ALT_ATTRIBUTE ] ),
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Registers the caption-as-alt attribute on the server so the block type
	 * knows about it (REST, server-side rendering, attribute validation).
	 *
	 * @param array  $args       Block type arguments.
	 * @param string $block_name Block name.
	 * @return array
	 */
	public static function register_image_attribute( $args, $block_name ) {
		if ( 'core/image' !== $block_name ) {
			return $args;
		}

		if ( ! isset( $args['attributes'] ) || ! is_array( $args['attributes'] ) ) {
			$args['attributes'] = array();
		}

		$args['attributes'][ self::CAPTION_ALT_ATTRIBUTE ] = array(
			'type'    => 'boolean',
			'default' => false,
		);

		return $args;
	}

	/**
	 * Enqueues the block editor script built by `@wordpress/scripts`.
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public static function enqueue_editor_assets() {
		$asset_path = SMART_MEDIA_MARKUP_DIR . 'build/index.asset.php';

		if ( ! file_exists( $asset_path ) ) {
			return;
		}

		$asset = include $asset_path;

		wp_enqueue_script(
			self::EDITOR_HANDLE,
			plugins_url( 'build/index.js', SMART_MEDIA_MARKUP_FILE ),
			isset( $asset['dependencies'] ) ? $asset['dependencies'] : array(),
			isset( $asset['version'] ) ? $asset['version'] : SMART_MEDIA_MARKUP_VERSION,
			true
		);

		wp_set_script_translations( self::EDITOR_HANDLE, 'smart-media-markup', SMART_MEDIA_MARKUP_DIR . 'languages' );
	}
}

<?php
/**
 * HTML transformations built on WP_HTML_Tag_Processor.
 *
 * @package SmartMediaMarkup
 */

namespace Smart_Media_Markup;

use WP_HTML_Tag_Processor;

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Applies the Smart Media Markup changes to a block's rendered HTML.
 *
 * Uses only the HTML API that ships with WordPress (no regular expressions,
 * no DOMDocument).
 */
final class Markup_Processor {

	/**
	 * Class added to the block's outer wrapper.
	 */
	const MARKER_CLASS = 'has-smart-media';

	/**
	 * Whitespace characters as defined by the HTML spec.
	 */
	const HTML_WHITESPACE = array( ' ', "\t", "\n", "\f", "\r" );

	/**
	 * Processes rendered block HTML.
	 *
	 * @param string $html    Rendered block HTML.
	 * @param array  $options {
	 *     Optional. Processing options.
	 *
	 *     @type bool $caption_as_alt Use the figcaption's plain text as alt text
	 *                                for images without alt text. Default false.
	 * }
	 * @return string Updated HTML.
	 */
	public static function process( $html, array $options = array() ) {
		if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_HTML_Tag_Processor' ) || '' === trim( $html ) ) {
			return $html;
		}

		$caption_text = '';
		if ( ! empty( $options['caption_as_alt'] ) ) {
			$caption_text = self::get_caption_text( $html );
		}

		$processor = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );

		// The first tag is the block's outer wrapper.
		if ( ! $processor->next_tag() ) {
			return $html;
		}

		$processor->add_class( self::MARKER_CLASS );

		do {
			$tag = $processor->get_tag();

			if ( 'IMG' === $tag ) {
				self::process_image( $processor, $caption_text );
			} elseif ( 'A' === $tag ) {
				self::process_link( $processor );
			}
		} while ( $processor->next_tag() );

		return $processor->get_updated_html();
	}

	/**
	 * Adds async decoding and, when given, caption-based alt text to an IMG.
	 *
	 * @param WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor    Processor positioned on an IMG.
	 * @param string                $caption_text Plain caption text, or ''.
	 * @return void
	 */
	private static function process_image( WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor, $caption_text ) {
		if ( null === $processor->get_attribute( 'decoding' ) ) {
			$processor->set_attribute( 'decoding', 'async' );
		}

		if ( '' === $caption_text ) {
			return;
		}

		$alt = $processor->get_attribute( 'alt' );
		if ( ! is_string( $alt ) || '' === trim( $alt ) ) {
			// set_attribute() escapes the value.
			$processor->set_attribute( 'alt', $caption_text );
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Adds `noopener` to links that point to another site, keeping existing rel values.
	 *
	 * @param WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor Processor positioned on an A tag.
	 * @return void
	 */
	private static function process_link( WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor ) {
		$href = $processor->get_attribute( 'href' );

		if ( ! is_string( $href ) || ! self::is_external_url( $href ) ) {
			return;
		}

		$rel    = $processor->get_attribute( 'rel' );
		$tokens = is_string( $rel ) ? self::split_tokens( $rel ) : array();

		if ( in_array( 'noopener', array_map( 'strtolower', $tokens ), true ) ) {
			return;
		}

		$tokens[] = 'noopener';
		$processor->set_attribute( 'rel', implode( ' ', $tokens ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Extracts the plain text of the first figcaption in the HTML.
	 *
	 * @param string $html Block HTML.
	 * @return string Plain text with collapsed whitespace, or ''.
	 */
	public static function get_caption_text( $html ) {
		$processor = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
		$inside    = false;
		$text      = '';

		while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
			$type = $processor->get_token_type();

			if ( '#tag' === $type ) {
				$tag = $processor->get_tag();

				if ( 'FIGCAPTION' === $tag ) {
					if ( $processor->is_tag_closer() ) {
						if ( $inside ) {
							break;
						}
					} else {
						$inside = true;
					}
					continue;
				}

				if ( $inside && 'BR' === $tag ) {
					$text .= ' ';
				}
				continue;
			}

			if ( $inside && '#text' === $type ) {
				// Returns the decoded text content of the node.
				$text .= $processor->get_modifiable_text();
			}
		}

		return self::collapse_whitespace( $text );
	}

	/**
	 * Determines whether a URL points to another site.
	 *
	 * @param string $url URL from an href attribute.
	 * @return bool
	 */
	public static function is_external_url( $url ) {
		$url = trim( $url );
		if ( '' === $url ) {
			return false;
		}

		$parts = wp_parse_url( $url );
		if ( ! is_array( $parts ) || empty( $parts['host'] ) ) {
			// Relative URLs, fragments, mailto:, tel:, etc.
			return false;
		}

		if ( isset( $parts['scheme'] ) && ! in_array( strtolower( $parts['scheme'] ), array( 'http', 'https' ), true ) ) {
			return false;
		}

		$is_external = ! in_array( self::normalize_host( $parts['host'] ), self::get_site_hosts(), true );

		/**
		 * Filters whether a link inside a media block is treated as external.
		 *
		 * @param bool   $is_external Whether the URL points to another site.
		 * @param string $url         The link URL.
		 */
		return (bool) apply_filters( 'smart_media_markup_is_external_url', $is_external, $url );
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the normalized hosts of this site.
	 *
	 * @return string[]
	 */
	private static function get_site_hosts() {
		$hosts = array();

		foreach ( array( home_url(), site_url() ) as $site_url ) {
			$host = wp_parse_url( $site_url, PHP_URL_HOST );
			if ( is_string( $host ) && '' !== $host ) {
				$hosts[] = self::normalize_host( $host );
			}
		}

		return array_unique( $hosts );
	}

	/**
	 * Normalizes a host for comparison (lowercase, no trailing dot, no "www.").
	 *
	 * @param string $host Host name.
	 * @return string
	 */
	private static function normalize_host( $host ) {
		$host = rtrim( strtolower( $host ), '.' );

		if ( 0 === strpos( $host, 'www.' ) ) {
			$host = substr( $host, 4 );
		}

		return $host;
	}

	/**
	 * Splits a space-separated token list (e.g. a rel attribute).
	 *
	 * @param string $value Attribute value.
	 * @return string[]
	 */
	private static function split_tokens( $value ) {
		$normalized = str_replace( self::HTML_WHITESPACE, ' ', $value );

		return array_values(
			array_filter(
				explode( ' ', $normalized ),
				static function ( $token ) {
					return '' !== $token;
				}
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Collapses runs of whitespace into single spaces and trims the result.
	 *
	 * @param string $text Text.
	 * @return string
	 */
	private static function collapse_whitespace( $text ) {
		return implode( ' ', self::split_tokens( $text ) );
	}
}

goes on that `<div>`.

`wp-env run tests-cli` or `bin/install-wp-tests.sh`):

```

=== Smart Media Markup ===
Contributors: smartmediamarkup
Tags: images, gallery, cover, accessibility, performance
Requires at least: 6.5
Tested up to: 6.9
Requires PHP: 7.4
Stable tag: 1.0.0

License URI: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html

Improves the front-end HTML of the core Image, Gallery and Cover blocks without changing saved content.

== Description ==

When the Image, Gallery and Cover blocks are rendered for visitors, the plugin:

1. Adds `decoding="async"` to images that don't already set a decoding mode.
2. Adds the class `has-smart-media` to the block's outer wrapper.
3. Adds `rel="noopener"` to links that point to another site, keeping any existing `rel` values.
4. Adds a "Use caption as alt text" toggle to the Image block sidebar. When it is on and the image has no alt text, the caption's plain text is used as the alt text.

All changes use the WordPress HTML API (`WP_HTML_Tag_Processor`) in `render_block_{$name}` filters. Stored post content is never modified.

= Filters =

* `smart_media_markup_block_names` – change the list of processed blocks.
* `smart_media_markup_is_external_url` – override whether a link counts as external.

== Development ==

    npm install
    npm run build

== Changelog ==

= 1.0.0 =
* Initial release.
